programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: Your mind is the scene of the crime. Box-office superstar Leonardo DiCaprio stars in this contemporary science fiction action film set "within the architecture of the mind." Written, directed and produced by Oscar and Golden Globe nominee Christopher Nolan (The Dark Knight, Batman Begins, The Prestige), this eagerly awaited follow-up to 2008's billion-dollar blockbuster is yet another visionary tale from a startingly original filmmaker who continually raises the bar with every film he makes. Shooting in London, Paris, Tangiers, Calgary and Los Angeles, Nolan's mind-bending film also stars Academy Award winners Michael Caine and Marion Cotillard, in addition to Juno's Ellen Page, Batman Begins' Cillian Murphy and Oscar nominees Ken Watanabe (The Last Samurai) and Tom Berenger (Platoon).

programme.title: The Legend Of Tarzan (2016)
programme.desc: A new live-action adventure from director David Yates (Harry Potter films) brings Edgar Rice Burroughs' legendary character back to the big screen. It's been years since the man once known as Tarzan (Alexander Skarsgard --True Blood) left the jungles of Africa behind for a gentrified life as John Clayton III, Lord Greystoke, with his beloved wife, Jane (Margot Robbie --The Wolf of Wall Street) at his side. Now, he has been invited back to the Congo to serve as a trade emissary of Parliament, unaware that he is a pawn in a deadly convergence of greed and revenge, masterminded by the Belgian, Captain Leon Rom (Oscar® winner Christoph Waltz). But those behind the murderous plot have no idea what they are about to unleash.

Brandon and Lori unearth a rare find with a potentially priceless payout. Andall bets are off when a bidding war over endangered species taxidermy ends in a heated stand-off with the local authorities.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S1 Ep.6: Gamblin' Gods

Everyone thinks he's crazy, but he knows something they don't. And later,vintage slot machines and poker tables send bidding through the roof. The closing price is stratospheric, but what's hidden from sight will be the ultimate payday for one lucky Storage Hunter.

programme.title: Storage Hunters S1 Ep.7: Disaster Strikes!

And later, Brandon and Lori think they've hit the jackpot with a cache of firearms, but when Lori's gun accidentally goes off inside the locker, Brandon is caught in the crosshairs.

And later, the contents of a unit spark an outrage among the buyers, but Brandon only sees dollar signs. Will he walk away or will this controversial cache crush his morals?

But first, Brandon and Lori face a shocking discovery when the contents of what look like an old retail store reveal their true identity. And later, some rare antiques fetch a fair price but further exploration of a hidden whale tusk could mean a windfall for one lucky storage hunter.

programme.title: The Assassination Of Jesse James By The Coward Robert Ford
programme.desc: International superstar Brad Pitt (Troy) stars as legendary outlaw Jesse James in this Western drama based on Ron Hansen's best-selling novel The Assassination Of Jesse James By The Coward Robert Ford. A charismatic, superstitious and moody man, Jesse James (Pitt) presides over a ragtag gang of outlaws who fear his quick temper and even quicker shooting ability. Young Robert Ford (Casey Affleck - Ocean's Twelve) worships Jesse and joins the James Gang, only to become resentful of his hero. Intent on taking Jesse's place, the young upstart hatches a plan to kill the fastest gun in the West. But after gunning Jesse James down, Robert Ford lives out the rest of his days tormented by the cold-blooded killing of his former mentor.

programme.title: Vacation
programme.desc: The next generation of Griswolds is at it again! Ed Helms (The Hangover films) and Christina Applegate (Anchorman films) star in this hilarious sequel to one of the funniest comedies ever made.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: A group of interconnected Baltimore-based twenty and thirtysomethings navigate their various relationships from the shallow end of the dating pool through the deep murky waters of married life trying to read the signs of the opposite sex - and hoping to be the exceptions to the no-exceptions rule. Gigi just wants a man who says he'll call - and does - while Alex advises her to stop sitting by the phone. Beth wonders if she should call it off after years of committed singlehood with her boyfriend Neil but he doesn't think there's a single thing wrong with their unmarried life. Janine's not sure if she can trust her husband Ben who can't quite trust himself around Anna. Anna can't decide between the sexy married guy or her straightforward no-sparks standby Conor who can't get over the fact that he can't have her. And Mary who's found an entire network of loving supportive men just needs to find one who's straight.

programme.title: Into The Storm
programme.desc: In the span of a single day, the town of Silverton is ravaged by an unprecedented onslaught of tornadoes. The entire town is at the mercy of the erratic and deadly cyclones, even as storm trackers predict the worst is yet to come. Most people seek shelter, while others run towards the vortex, testing how far a storm chaser will go for that once-in-a-lifetime shot. Told through the eyes and lenses of professional storm chasers, thrill-seeking amateurs, and courageous townspeople, "Into the Storm" throws you directly into the eye of the storm to experience Mother Nature at her most extreme.

programme.title: Pacific Rim
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmaker Guillermo del Toro (Pan's Labyrinth) brings out the big guns in this sci-fi action epic about a ragtag band of humans that band together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea. Using massive piloted robots to combat the alien threat, earth's survivors (including Charlie Hunnam, Charlie Day & Rinko Kikuchi) take the fight to the invading alien force lurking in the depths of the Pacific Ocean. Nearly defenseless in the face of the relentless enemy, the forces of mankind have no choice but to turn to two unlikely heroes -- a washed up former pilot and an untested trainee -- who now stand as earth's final hope against the mounting apocalypse.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.609: Night Animals
programme.desc: It's night time at Grandpa and Granny Pig's house, and Peppa and George have stayed up late to help hunt for slugs and snails.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.614: Mirrors
programme.desc: George has fun looking at himself in the mirror. Peppa and George try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.

programme.title: Peppa Pig S6 Ep.615: Pedro is Late
programme.desc: The playgroup is going on a trip to the museum. Everyone, is on the bus ready to go. But where is Pedro Pony?

programme.title: DORA S4 Ep.402: Mito Dreams of La Playa / Snake Bike
programme.desc: Dora helps her friend Mito the Yeti see the beach for the first time and he even wins the sandcastle competition! // On her way to the new bike park, Dora teaches Selena the Snake how to ride a bicycle.

programme.title: Dora S2 Ep.201: Backpack's Sticky Situation
programme.desc: Backpack has something special for Dora, but she can't open! They travel to Abuela on Tallest Mountain so she can fix her.

programme.title: Mr. Crocodile S1 Ep.112: Costume Croc / Plant Sitter Croc
programme.desc: Mr. Crocodile dresses as Super Crocodile for his first Halloween, and tries to live up to his new identity. // Daisy and Mr. Crocodile promise to take care of Mrs. Flores' prized plant, but keep putting it off for "later".

programme.title: BARBAPAPA - One Big Happy Family! S2 Ep.212: The Invasion / Prank Day
programme.desc: Barbalala receives a package and discovers little pink animals inside, which she calls the SQUEAKIES. // Barbabravo, Barbalala and Barbabeau are fed up with their brothers and sisters laughing at their expense.

programme.title: Barbapapa - One Big Happy Family! S1 Ep.105: The Orange Empire
programme.desc: The Barbapapas decide to go to the park. While her brother and sisters play , Barbalib can't help to control everything.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S1 Ep.106: The Crew Builds A Skate Park / The Crew Builds A Tunnel
programme.desc: The Crew has a mishap while building a skatepark. // The Crew helps a pop star get her tour bus to town.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew S2 Ep.223: The Crew Builds A Kangaroo Safari
programme.desc: Rubble & Crew build a kangaroo safari for Lucas and Lily right in the Bark Yard... until their construction kangaroo hops away!

programme.title: PAW Patrol S13 Ep.1303: Pups And The Alien Grandpa / Pups Save a Lemon-Loving Duckling
programme.desc: Cap'n Turbot tells the tale of how he learned to speak fluent "alien" while shipwrecked with an Alien Grandpa! // A lemon-loving baby duckling from Yumi's Farm gets mixed up in a delivery to Lizzy's Lemonade Shoppe.

programme.title: PAW Patrol S3 Ep.307: Pups Save Apollo
programme.desc: Apollo the Super Pup comes to Adventure Bay, in Rubble’s dream. The pups must rescue their super hero!

programme.desc: Accompanied by Nathalie Devantay, Annick Jeanmairet shares the secrets of lacto-fermentation and pickles. Discovery of the day: Manon's cheese platters, a young cheesemaker from Vaud who won the cheese platter prize at the Swiss Cheese Awards, with platters composed like works of art.

programme.title: Pistes Vertes Ep.36: The animal farm
programme.desc: Horses, goats, pigs and Norman chickens, in the Manche, an educational farm preserves local breeds. A baker in Bayeux, Christophe works closely with a miller and a farmer to make his bread in a very short supply chain. Meeting Maxime, a cabinetmaker working with reclaimed wood.

programme.title: Le Journal Afrique
programme.desc: All the African news from the TV5MONDE news staff.

programme.title: L'Actu
programme.desc: The televised news programme from TVMonaco.

programme.title: Le Journal De La Rts
programme.desc: All the news from RTS.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (8 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: 64' Actu
programme.desc: TV5MONDE's major daily news programme, decrypting the news! What you need to know: the Francophone view of the day's main events. Economics, social debates, international news: the expertise of our journalists. New weekend features: the French-speaking world, social networks, fake news, politics, sport...

programme.title: Allons-Y Franco !
programme.desc: Every Friday, journalists from the French-language media and TV5MONDE's partner channels share their views on current affairs.

programme.title: L'Invité
programme.desc: Patrick Simonin hosts the stars in the headlines, culture, music, film, books, an unmissable rendezvous with all those who light up our times.

programme.title: Histoires Et Leçons Ep.9: The Bird Who Looked Down on Others
programme.desc: Each episode tells a tale from a different country. The stories travel through time and space and convey universal human values.

programme.title: Les Mini-Héros De La Forêt Ep.3: The mystery of the missing bees
programme.desc: The gang of mini-heroes cherish the forest in which they live. So, whenever it comes to protecting or helping it, they don't hesitate to join forces and face their fears.

programme.title: My Class Ep.9: The subject of a verb
programme.desc: Spelling, grammar, conjugation: these essential French concepts are approached by teachers in a fun way to help children aged 9-12.

programme.title: Lilya Et Rayane Ep.19: Surprise Guest
programme.desc: Lilya and Rayane live in Morocco with their parents Salma and Saad. Going to the market, to school, doing the cleaning or going on a picnic: every day, daily tasks turn into little adventures.

programme.title: Lilya Et Rayane Ep.20: A Cat at Home
programme.desc: Lilya and Rayane live in Morocco with their parents Salma and Saad. Going to the market, to school, doing the cleaning or going on a picnic: every day, daily tasks turn into little adventures.

programme.title: C'Est Mathématique ! Avec Iman Ep.39: How do you construct a triangle using a compass?
programme.desc: Iman, a former maths teacher, offers primary school pupils a survival kit to help them approach secondary school with confidence. In each episode, using a fun and educational approach, he aims to make his subject clear and practical.

programme.title: Jad Et Ses Soeurs Ep.17: Car tour
programme.desc: Twin sisters Ranya and Syrine are as adorable as they are inseparable. Their lives are joyful and full of everyday adventures. But everything is about to be turned upside down with the arrival of their little brother, Jad.

programme.title: Mission Héros Ep.29: Road safety
programme.desc: At 8 years old, Amir leads the life of an everyday superhero. Thanks to his online avatar, he raises awareness among the children who watch him and throughout his neighborhood about civility and citizenship.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi Ep.25: The Love Parade
programme.desc: Charlie and Zach live in an apartment building with their parents. One day, a friendly monster appears at their home... His name is Compostman and he is directly connected to the planet's needs. Thanks to him, Charlie and Zach will learn everything about ecology.

programme.title: Compostman Et Moi Ep.26: Positive Attitude
programme.desc: The park's plants seem tired. Even Compostman's little flower is drooping. Could it be the bad mood in the air that's affecting them?

programme.title: Il Est Une Fois Ep.6: The princess with the little Marseilles sea urchins
programme.desc: What if the characters from the fairy tales of the past were living in today's world? From Marseilles to Brazzaville, via Montreal, we take you on a journey to discover some very special characters. There's a wolf on a motorbike, a Belgian Little Riding Hood and three little Corsican pigs!

programme.title: Chniwla Et Boubris Ep.25: Trap for Boubris
programme.desc: Boubris is an introverted lizard who dreams of peace and quiet. A former musician, he fled the hustle and settled away from the world. Until the day Chniwla, a hyperactive and intrusive mosquito, disrupts his daily life.

programme.title: Chniwla Et Boubris Ep.26: Mosquito-repelling lamp
programme.desc: Boubris is an introverted lizard who dreams of peace and quiet. A former musician, he fled the hustle and settled away from the world. Until the day Chniwla, a hyperactive and intrusive mosquito, disrupts his daily life.

programme.title: Cirkus Ep.15: Show-stopper
programme.desc: Fauve and Kenzo know that the troupe is in search of the best possible number to make the perfect grand finale. Each is determined to provide a real show-stopper to end the evening in style.

programme.title: Ma Vie Avec L'Ia Ep.9: Is AI eco-friendly?
programme.desc: Théo, a teenager, questions artificial intelligence directly to try to understand it better. He wants to know what it is made of, what feeds it, and how it analyzes data.

programme.title: Les Super-Pouvoirs Du Vivant Ep.15: The Clark's nutcracker
programme.desc: The animal kingdom is brimming with creatures that have extraordinary powers. To reveal the incredible inventiveness of nature and the importance of protecting it, each episode takes us on a fascinating journey rich in poetry and humour.

programme.title: Mission Info
programme.desc: News programme aimed at 7 to 11-year-olds! Each episode, devised for children and their parents, provides insight accessible to younger ones, combined with explanations, immersive reports and expert interviews. An educational quiz also gives children the chance to test their knowledge in a fun way.

programme.title: Château ! Ep.27: Saumur - La Chapelle-d'Angillon
programme.desc: Saumur: a fortress turned palace and later prison, overlooking the Loire, whose flamboyant Gothic style even inspired some of the castles seen in Disney films. The Château de la Chapelle-d'Angillon dates back to the 11th century. Its square keep is one of the oldest in the region.

programme.title: Falò
programme.desc: A news magazine show, "Falò" discusses and analyses current affairs in depth.

programme.title: Objectif Monde L'Hebdo
programme.desc: Report, inquiry, investigation ... "Objectif Monde L'Hebdo", a television magazine by French-speaking editorialists, takes time to reflect and analyse through the expert insights and opinions provided by specialists. A TV5MONDE programme, jointly produced with RTS, in collaboration with its francophone partners (RTBF, Radio-Canada, France Télévisions).

programme.title: Secrets De Nos Vallées Ep.3: The secret river of the migratory fish
programme.desc: In the Alpes-Maritimes, the gorges of the Cagne stretch through urbanized areas while hosting protected biodiversity. Here, using electric fishing techniques, the association Migrateurs Rhône-Méditerranée studies the migration of an endangered fish and fights against urbanization and pollution threatening the species.

programme.title: La Belle Vie Ep.13: Life for those who love the Great North
programme.desc: Julien meets Fabien, Raphaëlle and little Rose, a family who originally came from France to set up home with their sled dogs eight years ago. Today they live off-grid in the Yukon.

programme.title: Suisse En Scène
programme.desc: Interview with a key figure from the Swiss cultural scene. An opportunity to look back at their life and career, and the foundations that underpin their work.

programme.title: Rassemblance Ep.6: Mamari (Rwanda)
programme.desc: Born in Rwanda and arriving in France at the age of six months, Mamari chose humor to address her personal story, marked by family trauma and mental health issues. On stage, notably in "Too Funny to Die", she breaks taboos with powerful dark humor.

programme.title: Le Match Dans Le Match
programme.desc: A key figure from the world of sport looks back at a particular competition, a career, an outstanding moment.

programme.title: Le Téléjournal De Radio-Canada
programme.desc: The televised news programme from the Radio-Canada team.

programme.title: Papilles Ep.8: Savoie-Mont-Blanc with René and Maxime Meilleur (2/2)
programme.desc: In the heart of the Trois Vallées, father and son René and Maxime Meilleur have converted their modest family inn into a must gastronomic stop-off point. Welcome to Saint-Martin-de-Belleville, where you can sample the Michelin-star cuisine at the Chalet de La Bouitte! On the menu: blue cheese trout.

programme.title: Hep Taxi !
programme.desc: In town or in the countryside, day or night, Jérôme Colin, the presenter-taxi driver leads his prestigious customer on a four-wheel journey conducive to secrets.

programme.title: Cousu Ep.5: Denmark
programme.desc: In Denmark, the style of dress is expressed more broadly than might be expected. Here, some brands stand out for their durability and bite. Karine Vanasse meets Danish designers who defy the rules of fashion.

programme.title: Tendance Xxi Ep.19: Fashion special
programme.desc: Haute couture has once again given free rein to its boldest ideas: a look back at the Autumn/Winter 2026-2027 shows and a tour of Paris, Fashion Week style. Radical designs, a fresh take on everyday wardrobes, the Spring/Summer 2027 menswear look is set to change! The evidence from Men's Fashion Week.

programme.title: L'Épicerie
programme.desc: The place to be for all those who are interested in what they put on their plates and all things relating to food. The programme: reports, surveys, taste tests, test benches, answers to questions from television viewers, including advice and simple but effective tricks.

programme.title: Questions Pour Un Champion
programme.desc: A general knowledge quiz.

programme.title: Bye Bye La Suisse
programme.desc: In Thailand, as their tourist visas expire, the Dinaz family replace them with student visas. Jonathan makes the most of them to improve his English; Patricia begins learning Thai. In Greece, nothing is going according to plan for Alain and Anita.

programme.title: Parlons Éco
programme.desc: TV5MONDE's economic news bulletin, presented by Vicky Bogaert. "Parlons éco" analyses today's major trends and interviews the men and women who are starting businesses, innovating and imagining the economy of tomorrow.

programme.title: Le Journal De France 2
programme.desc: The television news programme of the France 2 editorial board (1 p.m. edition, Paris time).

programme.title: Le Quiz Des Champions
programme.desc: The greatest champions of television games compete. Who will be the champion of the champions?

programme.title: Heïdi'S Ice Ep.2: Conference in Svalbard
programme.desc: Heïdi Sevestre explains her work to the students of the University of Svalbard (UNIS), describing her methods and alarming conclusions. Her message is clear, it is urgent and essential to become involved and committed to sharing the knowledge.

programme.title: Opj Ep.5: Fatal ambition (1)
programme.desc: A dancer in a Gommance competition, a type of music from Réunion, kills herself in front of the police. She is believed to be intoxicated but was she the target? The case particularly affects the squad's new arrival, Tahia.

programme.title: Opj Ep.6: Fatal ambition (2)
programme.desc: The investigation focuses on the victim's rival artists. Was someone so ambitious they'd literally kill to win, to have the chance to release an album? By trying too hard to please, Tahia slips up.

programme.title: Futura ! Ep.8: Chasing Perfection
programme.desc: Anna, one of Switzerland's most talented young golfers, dreams of becoming a pro, but faces doubts and the pressure of a very selective environment.

Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.
